operatorProperties.code:
def process(reportCount) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = reportCount.copy()
    df.columns = ["year", "reports_raw"]

    # Keep only rows where year is a 4-digit year
    df = df[df["year"].astype(str).str.fullmatch(r"\d{4}", na=False)].copy()

    df["year"] = df["year"].astype(int)
    df["reports"] = (
        df["reports_raw"]
        .astype(str)
        .str.replace(",", "", regex=False)
        .str.replace(" ", "", regex=False)
    )
    df["reports"] = pd.to_numeric(df["reports"], errors="coerce")

    df = df.dropna(subset=["reports"])
    return df[["year", "reports"]].sort_values("year").reset_index(drop=True)

operators.customDisplayName: Clean reportCount table into numeric time series: rename columns to [year, reports_raw]; filter rows where year matches 4-digit regex ^\d{4}$; parse year as int; parse reports from reports_raw by removing commas/spaces and converting to numeric; drop rows with non-numeric reports; return [year, reports] sorted ascending by year.

operatorProperties.code:
def process(cleanReportCount) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = cleanReportCount.sort_values('year').copy()
    df['prev_reports'] = df['reports'].shift(1)
    df['rel_increase'] = (df['reports'] - df['prev_reports']) / df['prev_reports']

    # Focus on 2002-2024 inclusive (needs previous year present to compute 2002)
    df = df[(df['year'] >= 2002) & (df['year'] <= 2024)].copy()

    # Exclude cases where prev_reports is missing or zero
    df = df[(df['prev_reports'].notna()) & (df['prev_reports'] != 0)].copy()

    best = df.loc[df['rel_increase'].idxmax(), ['year', 'rel_increase', 'reports', 'prev_reports']]
    return pd.DataFrame([best.to_dict()])

operators.customDisplayName: Compute year-over-year relative increase in total reports: sort by year; create prev_reports=reports shifted by 1; compute rel_increase=(reports-prev_reports)/prev_reports; filter to years 2002-2024 inclusive; drop rows with missing/zero prev_reports; select the year with maximum rel_increase and return a 1-row table with [year, rel_increase, reports, prev_reports] for verification.
